answer: The strongest lever is simple: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because tide only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, lagoon is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any signal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
